items.reason: Location and branch confirmed via Tiendeo and Shopshours trading-hours listings for Madiba Park Shopping Centre, but the current liquor product range and in-store services for this specific Tops at Spar branch could not be independently confirmed from the available sources. Held pending a source that describes this branch's own offering rather than chain/aggregator listing data.

The United Furniture Outlets (UFO) retail format and group ownership (Lewis Group) is confirmed nationally, but no source captures this specific Game Centre branch's current product range, trading hours or branch-specific detail -- the Lewis Group brand page and a Brabys listing give chain-level information only. Held pending a source describing this branch directly.

The listed address, 18 Sapphire Street, Superbia, is independently confirmed by BUCO's own official store locator as the address of BUCO Polokwane-Sapphire (see the separate BUCO Polokwane listing in this chunk), raising an unresolved duplicate or business-name conflict at the same address. Held rather than published, merged or closed, pending clarification of whether this is a distinct trading business or a stale/duplicate listing for the BUCO branch.

A Polokwane municipal visitor guide lists a Chicken Licken at 142 New Era, Seshego, rather than clearly confirming the batch's Seshego Plaza Shop 36 address, leaving the branch's exact trading address unresolved. Held until the address conflict between the batch listing and the municipal guide is settled.

A Cylex directory listing gives address, phone and generic opening hours for this gym, but the gym's own current website and social channels were not available to confirm its CrossFit affiliation, specific class structure (30- and 60-minute sessions, an extra Saturday class) or that it still trades at 115 Diemeer Street. Held pending the gym's own current confirmation of these details.

A near-place directory listing confirms the guesthouse's address and phone number, but shows a placeholder 'open 24 hours' schedule, and the only other material found was a set of mostly critical customer reviews about room and bathroom condition. Room facilities and current services (air-conditioning, pool, bar, conference facility) are not confirmed by a reliable business-specific source, so the listing is held rather than published from reviews alone.

A Yellosa listing confirms the centre's mission statement, that it is contracted to most medical aids, and that it houses several practitioners including a physiotherapist and clinical psychologist, but its stated hours are internally inconsistent (e.g. Saturday '9am-11pm' alongside an '8-5' summary) and no own-site page was available to resolve the practitioner list or current hours. Held pending a source that clears up the conflicting hours and confirms the current practitioner mix.

The Mall of the North store directory and the mall's own About page confirm Game trades at this location with branch phone and hours, but no source describes this specific branch's current product range or departments -- national Game product information does not stand in for branch-specific stock. Held pending a source describing this branch's own offering.

The only substantive source is a 2018 newspaper article about the business opening as a car wash, lounge and hair salon on Van Warmelo Street, alongside a bare Cylex directory listing. Neither confirms whether the business still trades, at this address, with these services, years on. Held pending confirmation of its current trading status.

University of Limpopo accommodation information places MJ Gateway Lodge at 14 Geluk Street, Myngenoegen, Polokwane, not the Dalmada address carried on this listing, leaving the lodge's correct suburb and address unresolved. Held until the address conflict between the batch listing and the university's accommodation information is settled.

A Waze map entry and a Medpages practice entry place this optometry practice near Grobler Street in Polokwane Central, but neither confirms its current services or exact practice address with enough specificity, and the Vision Works branch page referenced for the group's service offering was not available. Held pending a source confirming this specific practice's own services and address.

A name search returned only unrelated home-repair advice pages, and the business's own site and its Localpx directory listing were not available in usable text, so the printing and signage services, vehicle/trailer branding work and Mankweng address carried on this listing remain unconfirmed. Held pending a source describing this business's own services and location.

Only an art.co.za gallery listing giving the museum's address, phone and a short description of its collection was available; no museum or Danie Hough Cultural Centre page was available to confirm current opening hours or a fuller account of the collection. Held pending a source that confirms the museum's current hours and collection detail.

A name search returned only unrelated Sanlam portal pages, and the shop's own business-site page was not available in usable text, so its floral and gift range, any delivery service and the Shop 16, Kirkade Arcade, 56 Schoeman Street address remain unconfirmed by a readable source. Held pending a source describing this shop's own offering.

JoJo's own distributor listing confirms SI Hardware And Sons as an official JoJo Tanks distributor at this Superbia address, but that listing only describes the JoJo distributorship, not the store's complete hardware or building-material range, and the address is also used for a separate store in batch chunk 014. Held pending a source describing this store's own full stock and resolving the shared-address question.
